model_annotation: This donut chart visually represents two distributions: the outer ring, labeled “Ambiguity Std (Outer)”, shows proportions for four standard deviation categories—Std: 0.0 (dark blue, 49.0%), Std: 0.47 (medium-dark blue, 47.7%), Std: 0.82 (medium-light blue, 5.0%), and Std: 0.94 (light blue, 7.0%)—with percentage labels directly on the respective segments; the inner ring, labeled “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”, displays proportions for three maximum ambiguity levels—Max: 1 (dark blue, 39.0%), Max: 2 (medium-light blue, 38.0%), and Max: 3 (light blue, 14.2%)—also with percentage labels. The chart includes two separate legends on the right, one for each ring, mapping the color shades to their corresponding categories. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order around each ring, with the outer ring’s largest segment at the top left and the inner ring’s largest segment at the bottom left.
